tables.label: Sundar all mentions
tables.what: Sundar all mentions, the Brandwatch alert-feed rows: X, Instagram, Facebook, Bluesky and Reddit, minutes behind. X posts come with their words.

tables.label: Sonar
tables.what: The Sonar feed: X, YouTube, Bluesky, Instagram, TikTok, Reddit and more, minutes after posting.

tables.label: Brandwatch stored mentions
tables.what: Brandwatch's stored mentions: news, Reddit, forums, blogs, reviews, Bluesky, Instagram, YouTube and Facebook. A day's mentions arrive the day after, and its X rows have no words, so they never match.

tables.label: Sprinklr comments
tables.what: Comments, replies and mentions on Google's own posts and accounts: Instagram, X, Facebook, YouTube, TikTok, Threads and LinkedIn, minutes behind. Google's own posts are left out. A comment's link opens the post it is under.

tables.label: Tubular videos
tables.what: Tubular's videos that mention Google: YouTube, Instagram, Facebook and TikTok, searched by their titles (it has no descriptions or transcripts). A day or two behind.

alerts.posts:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT IF(LOWER(SocialNetwork) = 'twitter', 'x', LOWER(SocialNetwork)) AS platform, authorHandle AS author,
      snippet AS text, url, postTime AS posted, followers, engagementScore AS eng, LOWER(Sentiment) AS sentiment,
      CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS language, CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS shares, CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS replies,
      ingestionTimestamp AS seen, url AS one
    FROM `brand-social-central-data.social_alerts_dataset.all_sundar_mentions`
    WHERE ingestionTimestamp >= @t_from AND ingestionTimestamp < TIMESTAMP_ADD(@t_to, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
),
typed AS (
  SELECT *, LOWER(IFNULL(text, '')) AS text_l, LOWER(IFNULL(author, '')) AS author_l, LOWER(IFNULL(url, '')) AS url_l
  FROM base WHERE posted >= @t_from AND posted < @t_to
),
hits AS (
  SELECT * FROM typed
  WHERE (IFNULL(REGEXP_CONTAINS(text_l, @q3), FALSE) AND (IFNULL(REGEXP_CONTAINS(text_l, @q4), FALSE) OR IFNULL(REGEXP_CONTAINS(text_l, @q5), FALSE)))
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY one ORDER BY seen DESC) = 1
)
SELECT platform, author, SUBSTR(text, 1, 2000) AS text, url, posted, followers, eng, sentiment, language,
  shares, replies, one, COUNT(*) OVER () AS matched, MAX(posted) OVER () AS newest
FROM hits
ORDER BY IFNULL(eng, -1) DESC, posted DESC
LIMIT @lim

brandwatch.posts:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT CASE LOWER(platform) WHEN 'twitter' THEN 'x' WHEN 'facebook_public' THEN 'facebook'
        WHEN 'instagram_public' THEN 'instagram' WHEN 'linkedin_brand_mentions' THEN 'linkedin' ELSE LOWER(platform) END AS platform,
      author,
      CASE WHEN TRIM(IFNULL(mention_text, '')) = '' THEN NULLIF(TRIM(IFNULL(title, '')), '')
        WHEN TRIM(IFNULL(title, '')) = '' OR STARTS_WITH(mention_text, SUBSTR(TRIM(title), 1, 30)) THEN mention_text
        ELSE CONCAT(TRIM(title), ': ', mention_text) END AS text,
      post_url AS url, published_timestamp AS posted, CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS followers,
      SAFE_CAST(ROUND(engagement_score) AS INT64) AS eng, LOWER(sentiment) AS sentiment, LOWER(language) AS language,
      CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS shares, CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS replies, load_timestamp AS seen, mention_id AS one
    FROM `brand-social-central-data.raw_data.brandwatch_raw_mentions_base`
    WHERE report_date BETWEEN DATE_SUB(DATE(@t_from), INTERVAL 1 DAY) AND DATE_ADD(DATE(@t_to), INTERVAL 1 DAY)
      AND mention_id IS NOT NULL
),
typed AS (
  SELECT *, LOWER(IFNULL(text, '')) AS text_l, LOWER(IFNULL(author, '')) AS author_l, LOWER(IFNULL(url, '')) AS url_l
  FROM base WHERE posted >= @t_from AND posted < @t_to
),
hits AS (
  SELECT * FROM typed
  WHERE (IFNULL(REGEXP_CONTAINS(text_l, @q3), FALSE) AND (IFNULL(REGEXP_CONTAINS(text_l, @q4), FALSE) OR IFNULL(REGEXP_CONTAINS(text_l, @q5), FALSE)))
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY one ORDER BY seen DESC) = 1
)
SELECT platform, author, SUBSTR(text, 1, 2000) AS text, url, posted, followers, eng, sentiment, language,
  shares, replies, one, COUNT(*) OVER () AS matched, MAX(posted) OVER () AS newest
FROM hits
ORDER BY IFNULL(eng, -1) DESC, posted DESC
LIMIT @lim

sprinklr.posts:
WITH base AS (
    SELECT IF(LOWER(platform) = 'twitter', 'x', LOWER(platform)) AS platform, author_username AS author,
      comment_text AS text, post_url AS url, comment_timestamp AS posted, SAFE_CAST(author_followers AS INT64) AS followers,
      SAFE_CAST(ROUND(IFNULL(comment_like_count, 0) + IFNULL(comment_reply_count, 0)) AS INT64) AS eng,
      LOWER(sentiment) AS sentiment, CAST(NULL AS STRING) AS language, CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS shares,
      CAST(NULL AS INT64) AS replies, comment_timestamp AS seen, comment_id AS one
    FROM `brand-social-central-data.reporting_data.sprinklr_inbound_comments`
    WHERE comment_timestamp >= @t_from AND comment_timestamp < TIMESTAMP_ADD(@t_to, INTERVAL 24 HOUR)
      AND comment_id IS NOT NULL AND IFNULL(is_brand_post, '') != 'Brand'
      AND LOWER(IFNULL(is_deleted, 'false')) != 'true' AND LOWER(IFNULL(is_spam, 'false')) != 'true'
      AND LOWER(IFNULL(is_hidden, 'false')) != 'true'
),
typed AS (
  SELECT *, LOWER(IFNULL(text, '')) AS text_l, LOWER(IFNULL(author, '')) AS author_l, LOWER(IFNULL(url, '')) AS url_l
  FROM base WHERE posted >= @t_from AND posted < @t_to
),
hits AS (
  SELECT * FROM typed
  WHERE (IFNULL(REGEXP_CONTAINS(text_l, @q3), FALSE) AND (IFNULL(REGEXP_CONTAINS(text_l, @q4), FALSE) OR IFNULL(REGEXP_CONTAINS(text_l, @q5), FALSE)))
  QUALIFY ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY one ORDER BY seen DESC) = 1
)
SELECT platform, author, SUBSTR(text, 1, 2000) AS text, url, posted, followers, eng, sentiment, language,
  shares, replies, one, COUNT(*) OVER () AS matched, MAX(posted) OVER () AS newest
FROM hits
ORDER BY IFNULL(eng, -1) DESC, posted DESC
LIMIT @lim
